{{short description|Swedish mathematician}}
'''Tord Hall''' (7 January 1910 - 30 September 1987) was a [[Sweden|Swedish]] [[mathematician]], university professor and bestselling author.

== Life ==

He was born in 1910 in [[Jönköping]], Sweden,<ref name="nationalencyklopedin1">{{cite web|url=http://www.ne.se/tord-hall |title=Tord Hall &#124; Nationalencyklopedin |publisher=Ne.se |date= |accessdate=2014-01-06}}</ref> and died in 1987.<ref name="nationalencyklopedin1"/>

== Career ==

He completed his Ph.D. in mathematics from [[Uppsala University]].<ref name="mathgen1">{{cite web|url=http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=20037 |title=The Mathematics Genealogy Project - Tord Hall |publisher=Genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu |date= |accessdate=2014-01-06}}</ref> His PhD advisor was [[Arne Beurling]].<ref name="mathgen1"/> The title of his PhD thesis was ''On Polynomials bounded at an Infinity of Points''.

From 1959 to 1975, he was a professor of mathematics at Uppsala University.<ref name="nationalencyklopedin1"/> He published several mathematical theorems.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Hayman |first1=W. K. |title=On a theorem of Tord Hall |journal=Duke Mathematical Journal |date=March 1974 |volume=41 |issue=1 |pages=25–26 |url=http://projecteuclid.org/DPubS?service=UI&version=1.0&verb=Display&handle=euclid.dmj/1077310221 |doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-74-04103-9|accessdate=2014-01-06|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

In addition to his academic career, he also worked as an employee for newspaper [[Svenska Dagbladet]] and [[Sveriges Radio]], the national Swedish radio.

== Bibliography ==

He is most well known as the biographer of [[Carl Gauss]] (''Biography of Carl Gauss'').<ref>{{cite web|url={{google books |plainurl=y |id=ysxT4lHzqtwC}} |title=A History of Modern Planetary Physics: Transmuted Past |author=Stephen G. Brush |date=1996-02-23 |accessdate=2014-01-06}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url={{google books |plainurl=y |id=tdO5-P4nRl|p=38}} |title=Mathematical Puzzling |author= Martin Gardiner|date= |accessdate=2014-01-06}}</ref>
It was translated into English by [[Albert Froderberg]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bibliopolis.com/main/books/2619030.html |title=Carl Friedrich Gauss, A Biography by Tord Hall. by (Hall, Tord.) from Richard Press Art Books &#124; Sacramento, CA |publisher=Bibliopolis |date= |accessdate=2014-01-06}}</ref>

The book generally received favorable reviews.<ref>{{cite web|author=Tord Hall |url=https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/741341.Tord_Hall |title=Tord Hall (Author of Carl Friedrich Gauss) |publisher=Goodreads.com |date= |accessdate=2014-01-06}}</ref>
